schemaFindings.atlas_packets.chunk_id: uuid, type/shape-compatible with codebase_chunk_index.id (the row PK), NOT with codebase_chunk_index.chunk_id (the durable "card:<source_ref>:<hash>" text identity)
schemaFindings.codebase_chunk_index.id: uuid PK, DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() -- an ephemeral row identifier, not guaranteed stable across reprocessing/rebuild
schemaFindings.codebase_chunk_index.chunk_id: text, durable content-derived identity, 55816/55853 populated repo-wide (verified separately, not part of this population)
schemaFindings.durableIdentityCaveat: Among EXACT_INDEX_ID_MATCH rows, 0/0 also carry a non-null durable text chunk_id on the matched codebase_chunk_index row. This means atlas_packets.chunk_id currently resolves via the EPHEMERAL row PK, not the durable identity -- a future codebase_chunk_index rebuild that regenerates ids would silently break this resolution even though the durable chunk_id text would be unchanged. Not a blocker for this census (we are only asked whether it resolves TODAY), but load-bearing for whether ProjectionRegistryV1 should key off codebase_chunk_index.id (ephemeral) or codebase_chunk_index.chunk_id (durable) going forward.
schemaFindings.revisionComparability: No revision-comparable column exists on codebase_chunk_index (only updated_at / embedding_created_at timestamps, no workspace_revision/source_revision analog). REVISION_DISAGREEMENT was therefore never evaluated as a bucket -- reporting it as "agrees" would be fabricated. 0 EXACT_INDEX_ID_MATCH rows had this check skipped, not silently passed.

verdict: chunk_id is DEFINITIVELY RULED OUT as the packet->chunk resolver. Not partial coverage -- zero live resolutions (0/1390), including the 6 rows where it is populated (they match nothing on either the ephemeral-PK path or the durable-text-identity path).

otherPacketColumnsCheckedThisPass.symbol_version_id: Column does not exist on atlas_packets. Only symbol_id (uuid) exists, populated 6/1390 -- same order of magnitude as chunk_id/sha256, not independently checked further since it shares the same near-zero coverage pattern.
otherPacketColumnsCheckedThisPass.content_hash_plus_source_revision: content_hash populated 16/1390 (1.1%) on atlas_packets. No source_revision column exists anywhere to pair with it (neither atlas_packets nor codebase_chunk_index). Ruled out on both criteria.
otherPacketColumnsCheckedThisPass.byte_start_byte_end: 0/1390 populated (already ruled out prior to this run, re-confirmed by column list).
otherPacketColumnsCheckedThisPass.tree_node_id: NEW LEAD, not on the originally requested candidate list, found via a full atlas_packets column scan. Populated 1390/1390 (100%) -- unlike every other candidate. FOREIGN KEY to atlas_ast_nodes.tree_node_id (PK). atlas_ast_nodes carries: relative_path, repo_id, start_byte/end_byte, line_start/line_end, source_content_hash, source_revision, normalized_node_hash -- a real symbol/AST-node identity contract, not sparse metadata. codebase_chunk_index independently carries relative_path, repo_id, line_start/line_end, content_hash -- the same field *names* on both sides, which is a materially stronger join surface than source_ref alone (adds repo_id + a line range + a content hash, none of which fan out the way a bare source_ref does). NOT YET TESTED for cardinality-1 resolution, join-key type compatibility, or whether atlas_ast_nodes.relative_path/repo_id actually match codebase_chunk_index.relative_path/repo_id in practice (same-name columns are not proof of same-value population -- this must be verified live, not assumed, before treating it as a resolver). This is a candidate for PACKET-CHUNK-RESOLVE-01B if pursued, not yet built or run.
